name: Pitch deck outline
pitch: Writes a brand partnership pitch deck outline using the person's metrics and existing content.
instructions: Start by listing the person's metrics and any existing pitch material. Read the most recent metrics file with file_read. If no metrics file exists, ask the person to share their key numbers. When you have the metrics, open a new page with make_page and create a structured outline: intro, brand fit, audience, metrics, proposal, next steps. Write each section as a brief bullet point using the person's own words and numbers. When the outline is complete, save the page to the workspace with file_write and show the final outline to the person. If any step finds nothing, say what is missing and stop.
starters: write deck structure with my metrics

examples.does: reads metrics file, creates outline, saves and shows it

readme:
# Pitch deck outline
Writes a brand partnership pitch deck outline using your metrics and existing content.

What it needs: file_read, file_write, make_page
What it will not do: design slides, pull in external data, or sign contracts.
